premises.text: Power outages are a widespread problem affecting all socioeconomic classes in Nigeria
premises.evidence_span: contrast that with 175 million Nigerians experience blackouts every day. And it's not just the poor, it's not just the middle class, but it's the rich as well.

premises.text: Businesses incur high costs to run backup generators due to unreliable power supply
premises.evidence_span: it costs four times the amount to run a backup generator than it costs to get power from the grid.

premises.text: A software and hardware platform can provide real-time power outage notifications
premises.evidence_span: we created SOP Notify. It's a software and hardware platform where we take low-cost Android phones just like this and we turn them into power sensors to let our users know when there's power available in their community.

premises.text: Users can receive notifications about power status and report issues through the app
premises.evidence_span: she'll get a push notification that the power has been restored... she can go ahead and report that to the power company.

premises.text: Power companies can use the platform to communicate directly with their customers
premises.evidence_span: our main customers are the power companies, and they can use our platform to communicate directly with their customers.

premises.text: The electricity market in Africa is underproducing relative to demand
premises.evidence_span: the electricity market in Africa is a 27 billion dollar market, and they're only producing 50 percent of the power that people actually need.

premises.text: The number of mobile phones in Africa is rapidly increasing, providing a large user base for the platform
premises.evidence_span: In the next five years, there will be over 1 billion mobile phones in Africa alone, and 600 million of those will be smartphones.

value.text: Users gain timely information about power availability, improving their daily lives
value.evidence_span: let our users know when there's power available in their community.

notes: Pilot with Ibadan Power Company and potential for bill payments are excluded as traction.
